note: Measured phase costs of optimizer runs, read by tools/progress_server.py to weight its progress bars and ETA. Kernel phases: secs is wall time of the batch, asleep is the part the machine slept; cost per step = (secs - asleep) * threads / (jobs * iters). The watcher appends finished runs to out/phase_costs.json (seeded from this file). The 2026-10-18 record predates the 2026-10-19 rulings pass (the kernel now costs 1.3-1.7x more per step), and its iters are the standard command's (--iters 360000 --p2-iters 4400000; the bench default 400000), which that log does not print.
